name: whisper.cpp
summary: Georgi Gerganov's ultra-fast C/C++ local speech-to-text engine enabling 100% private offline voice-input roleplay in SillyTavern & Open WebUI.
ranking_rationale: Blazing real-time local microphone transcription on CPU, Apple Silicon Metal, Vulkan & CUDA (trade-off: CLI/server component paired behind a chat UI rather than a standalone companion app).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Blazing real-time local microphone transcription on CPU, Apple Silicon Metal, Vulkan & CUDA
Zero cloud audio uploads—speak privately to local companions completely offline
Tiny standalone binary from the creator of llama.cpp
cons: CLI/server component paired behind a chat UI rather than a standalone companion app
Requires downloading GGML Whisper model weights
